analysis: The north star prioritizes publishing a reproducible observation of a known workflow and an honest account of limits, with LH001 as the standard candle. The most valuable next work is therefore to finish the first end-to-end observation, then support it with the question register and measurement tasks that make the evidence interpretable. There is also a small cluster of foundational getting-started items that can be swept once the core observation path is underway.

options.title: Observe one dispatch end to end
options.goal: Complete the urgent end-to-end observation task by following one dispatch through the full workflow and capturing what happened in a reproducible way. Make sure the result is concrete enough to serve as the first standard candle for later comparisons, with any limitations or gaps stated plainly.
options.reasoning: This is the most direct step toward the north star and anchors all later measurement.

options.title: Clarify task routing for dispatched work
options.goal: Resolve the high-priority question of which model should take which kind of dispatched task, using the current workflow evidence. Produce a clear answer that can guide the observation run and make the dispatch process more reproducible.
options.reasoning: It supports the observation pipeline by making the workflow legible before wider measurement work expands.

options.title: Record the evidence infrastructure
options.goal: Work through the related recordkeeping and sampling tasks so the project can compare observations against stable inputs. Focus on exporting Harbour's records and sampling the host in a way that supports honest, repeatable measurement, and leave the outputs ready for later writeup.
options.reasoning: These are the main enabling pieces for turning a single observation into credible evidence.

options.title: Start the question register and ledger
options.goal: Set up the question register and keep a ledger so future observations have a traceable place to land. Aim to establish the minimum structure needed to track open questions, link evidence, and avoid treating raw counts as conclusions.
options.reasoning: It builds the interpretive scaffolding needed for the north star's honest account of limits.

options.title: Sweep the remaining getting-started queue
options.goal: Tackle the remaining normal-priority getting-started items in one pass, focusing on the historical propagation case and the survey-of-surveys work. Use this run to reduce queue noise and surface any useful context for later observations without drifting away from the core publishing objective.
options.reasoning: This clears the smaller backlog items that can inform the research path without blocking it.

options.title: Continue until stopped
options.reasoning: No specific goal — walk the stack under the precedence policy and keep making progress until you need the human.

North star (current intent):
Lighthouse publishes one reproducible observation of a known workflow and an honest account of its limits.

We keep going until the results are interesting: writing worth reading, evidence that we are measuring real phenomena, and a clear relation to wider research. Task counts do not count. Publishing stays a human decision, as cutting a release is in Harbour's charter. LH001 is the standard candle, the known light by which unknown ones are measured: until it exists, outward numbers are only counts.
